description: Coarse, auditable article-level labels for the FLAN-T5-Large v0.3 development benchmark. These labels are deterministic coarsenings of the v0.1 GPT-5.6 silver annotations, not new human ground truth.

shock_scope.idiosyncratic: The primary shock concerns one firm, whether the target or one sector peer.
shock_scope.common: The shock explicitly affects several sector firms, the sector, or the broad market.
shock_scope.mixed: Material firm-specific and common components coexist.
shock_scope.unclear: The supplied text is irrelevant, insufficient, or does not establish scope.

event_family.earnings_guidance: Reported results, forecasts, outlook, or guidance.
event_family.product_demand: Products, technology, customers, contracts, or demand.
event_family.supply_capacity: Supply chains, production capacity, manufacturing constraints, or inventory availability.
event_family.regulation_legal: Regulation, trade policy, litigation, governance, or operational/legal matters.
event_family.corporate_analyst: Analyst actions or corporate actions such as M&A, financing, restructuring, or management changes.
event_family.other_or_unclear: No listed family is supported or the family is unclear.

information_status.confirmed: Completed, officially announced, filed, reported, or enacted.
information_status.anticipated: Scheduled, planned, forecast, expected, or upcoming.
information_status.unclear: The status is not established by the supplied text.

directional_alignment.single_firm_only: The shock is idiosyncratic and no explicit same/opposite peer effect is stated.
directional_alignment.same_direction: The target and sector/peers are explicitly affected in the same direction.
directional_alignment.opposite_direction: The target benefits at peers' expense, or vice versa.
directional_alignment.common_direction_unclear: A common or mixed shock exists, but its directional alignment is not established.
directional_alignment.unclear: The article is inapplicable or its shock scope is unclear.

mapping_notes.shock_scope: Fine relevance labels irrelevant and insufficient override fine event_scope and map to unclear.
mapping_notes.directional_alignment: Inapplicable or unclear-scope records map to unclear. For idiosyncratic scope, an explicit same_direction or opposite_direction peer_effect takes priority; otherwise the label is single_firm_only. For common or mixed scope, explicit peer_effect takes priority, followed by an explicit target/sector direction comparison; remaining cases map to common_direction_unclear.
mapping_notes.evaluation_claim: Report agreement with a deterministically coarsened GPT-5.6 silver reference. Do not call these labels human ground truth.
